أتسامح (form VI)
# أَتَسَامَحُ (ʔatasāmaḥu) /ʔa.ta.saː.ma.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# أَتَسَامَحَ (ʔatasāmaḥa) /ʔa.ta.saː.ma.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# أَتَسَامَحْ (ʔatasāmaḥ) /ʔa.ta.saː.maħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
